study: Which numerical method does the engine use? A learned continuous vector field integrated by four named solvers, family x solver x bounding over 5 seeds.

verdict.reading: 24 cells of the integrator grid were trained under one protocol. The console's own second-order coefficient, fitted the same least-squares way as every arm's, is 0.4956 horizontally and 0.1912 pooled, near the 0.5 of a second-order method. That slope is a tail statistic, not the engine's rule: it comes from 13 of 1792 frames (mean residual -17.73 subpixels) while 93.5% of frames satisfy the first-order identity exactly, and on contact-free frames alone the slope is 0.0720. The arms measure euler 0.000, symplectic 1.000, midpoint 0.504, rk4 0.501; the lowest held-out position error is euler at 0.1056 px. Projecting the bounds inside the step changes the out-of-bounds rate by euler -0.188, symplectic -0.188, midpoint -0.188, rk4 -0.188.
